propositions: Test fixtures that create bare repositories fail when invoked with implicit discovery (cwd or git -C) under protected safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, returning fatal error 128 on git config and git symbolic-ref commands.

Commands intentionally operating on bare test repositories must explicitly target them using top-level --git-dir rather than relying on implicit discovery through working directory or git -C, to remain compatible with strict Git safety policies.

Generic subprocess helpers that serve both worktrees and bare repositories cannot use blanket conversion to explicit targeting without breaking worktree semantics; repair requires narrow bare-only helpers at confirmed call sites.

Bare-repository fixture and restore operations must be made portable across default and explicit safe.bareRepository configurations without weakening host, global, system, or repository Git safety settings.

The production script infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore initializes and operates on a throwaway restore.git bare repository through shared run_git helpers and must be repaired alongside test fixtures.
Worktree-oriented test helpers and production code paths retain existing -C behavior and unchanged upkeep pins, fail-fast checks, and error propagation after bare-only sibling repair.
